commission_all.name: commission_all
commission_all.description: k dealers send signed invalid shares to everyone (CORRUPT_ALL).

commission_selective.name: commission_selective
commission_selective.description: k dealers send signed invalid shares to t honest targets, valid ones to the rest (SELECTIVE).

omission.name: omission
omission.description: k dealers send nothing to t honest targets and never answer (WITHHOLD).

omission_cured.name: omission_cured
omission_cured.description: k dealers withhold from t targets, then answer on-chain (WITHHOLD_THEN_ANSWER).

bad_answer.name: bad_answer
bad_answer.description: k dealers withhold, then answer with an invalid share (BAD_ANSWER).

bad_pok.name: bad_pok
bad_pok.description: k dealers anchor an invalid PoK (BAD_POK).

false_accuser.name: false_accuser
false_accuser.description: k nodes dispute one honest dealer's VALID share (FALSE_ACCUSER).

false_complainer.name: false_complainer
false_complainer.description: k nodes claim non-delivery against t honest dealers (FALSE_COMPLAINER).

mixed.name: mixed
mixed.description: k faulty nodes cycling CORRUPT_ALL, WITHHOLD, FALSE_ACCUSER, SELECTIVE, FALSE_COMPLAINER.

absent.name: absent
absent.description: k nodes never register (crash before the run).

slow_links.name: slow_links
slow_links.description: k honest nodes with 20x outbound latency, beyond the bound Delta used to plan the windows.

long_partition.name: long_partition
long_partition.description: t+1 honest nodes cut off from everyone, chain included, from DEALING start to COMPLAINT end.

crash_beyond_t.name: crash_beyond_t
crash_beyond_t.description: t+1 honest nodes crash when KEY_DERIVATION opens.
